description: 1D distributed-load radial feeder. Series R+jX dominant (high R/X, resistive), shunt capacitance negligible (short/medium line, no Ferranti). Voltage profile V(x) and current I(x) along the feeder solved as a coupled 1D ODE / boundary-value problem with distributed load density. Losses proportional to I^2*R. Voltage regulation checked against ANSI C84.1 band.
source: Kersting (2012), Distribution System Modeling and Analysis, 3rd ed., CRC Press; Gonen (2014), Electric Power Distribution Engineering, 3rd ed.; ANSI C84.1-2020 voltage ranges.

unit.name: Generic 11kV Radial Distribution Feeder — Distributed Load

X_ohm_per_km.note: Series reactance per phase (R/X~0.9 — high, resistive distribution feeder)

n_sections.note: Number of spatial discretization sections along feeder

ansi_band_pct.note: ANSI C84.1 Range A service voltage band (+/-5%)
